scripts.docs:build: python3 scripts/diagrams.py && python3 scripts/md2docx.py docs/WHAT_WE_BUILT.md /tmp/what-we-built.html && soffice --headless --convert-to docx:"MS Word 2007 XML" --outdir /tmp /tmp/what-we-built.html && mv /tmp/what-we-built.docx docs/WHAT_WE_BUILT.docx
scripts.lint: biome lint apps/orchestrator packages scripts tests index.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/orchestrator typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/worker typecheck && bun run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.docs:email-templates: bun run scripts/gen-email-templates.ts && bun run scripts/gen-email-templates-html.ts && python3 scripts/md2docx.py docs/EMAIL_TEMPLATES.md /tmp/email-templates.html && soffice --headless --convert-to docx:"MS Word 2007 XML" --outdir /tmp /tmp/email-templates.html && mv /tmp/email-templates.docx docs/email-templates.docx
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it email-pg psql -U email -d email_orchestrator
